cold_start: Task1 starts empty; Task2-Task5 inherit own preceding endpoint module statistics
direction: fixed 8x8 two-sided CountSketch of effective BA difference, normalized to unit length
memory: one bounded EMA state per module, no task-specific arrays, no text, no historical per-client vectors
norm: Frobenius norm of scale*(B_local*A_local-B_global*A_global), divided by frozen current LR before log
risk: 1 minus fixed-reference Shadow security factor (1-malicious_step_fraction)^7; not calibrated probability
scope: risk-aware update retention, not a semantic safety guarantee
selection: preregistered exploratory defaults; no hyperparameter selection using formal tests
